newsitem.title: CHINA: Tung Fong considers new share placement.
newsitem.headline: Tung Fong considers new share placement.

text.p: Tung Fong Hung (Holdings) Ltd said on Wednesday it was considering a private placement of new shares representing up to 20 percent of its existing issued share capital to independent third parties.
"No decision has been made to proceed with such a placing and no legally binding agreement has been entered into by the company," Tung Fong Hung said in a statement.
The Chinese medicine and health food retailer said the proceeds of an issue would be used for general working capital.
Trading in Tung Fong Hung shares was suspended on Tuesday and was due to resume on Wednesday.
The stock last traded at HK$0.445.
